passages.title: 沒精神的小狗
passages.text: Our dog, Lucky, usually has a lot of {1}. He runs around the yard all day long. But last week, he just lay in a {2} of the living room and didn't want to eat. We were worried, so we took him to the animal hospital. The doctor did a few {3} on him. "He's not sick," she said. "He's just too hot. His fur is very {4}, and this summer is really hot." She {5} that we cut his fur short and give him more cold water. That afternoon, Dad took Lucky to a pet shop for a haircut. When he came home, he looked so small and funny that we all laughed. But the next morning, Lucky jumped onto my bed and licked my face. He was back to his old self again!

blanks.why: have a lot of energy「精力充沛」，後面說牠整天在院子裡跑。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、garbage（垃圾）放進去都說不通。
in a corner of the living room「在客廳的一個角落」。energy（精力）、headache（頭痛）、test（測驗）都不能表示地點。
do tests on…「對…做檢查」，醫生幫狗做檢查。corners（角落）、headaches（頭痛）、energies（精力）都不能「做」在狗身上。
His fur is very thick「牠的毛很厚」，所以才會太熱。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容毛。
suggest that + 子句「建議…」。woke（叫醒）、raised（舉起）、tested（測試）後面都不能接 that 子句表示建議。

passages.zh: 我們家的狗 Lucky 平常精力充沛，整天在院子裡跑來跑去。但上星期，牠只是躺在客廳的角落，什麼都不想吃。我們很擔心，就帶牠去動物醫院。醫生幫牠做了幾項檢查。「牠沒有生病，」她說，「只是太熱了。牠的毛很厚，今年夏天又真的很熱。」她建議我們把牠的毛剪短，並多給牠喝冷水。那天下午，爸爸帶 Lucky 去寵物店剪毛。牠回家時看起來又小又滑稽，我們全都笑了。不過隔天早上，Lucky 跳上我的床舔我的臉，牠又變回原本那隻活潑的狗了！

passages.title: 公園角落的吉他少年
passages.text: A new family moved into the apartment next to ours last month. They have a son named Ray, who is about my age. Every evening, he sat alone in a {1} of the park and played the guitar. He played beautifully, but he was very {2}. When people stopped to listen, he stopped playing. One evening, I sat down near him and {3} him a bottle of cold water. We started talking, and I found out that he wanted to join our school band. However, he was afraid to sing in front of others. I {4} that he practice with me first, because I play the drums. For two weeks, we practiced together every day. Then we went to see the band teacher. When Ray finished his song, all the band members {5} their hands and voted yes. Now he's our lead singer!

blanks.why: in a corner of the park「在公園的一個角落」。energy（精力）、headache（頭痛）、test（測驗）都不能表示地點。
very shy「很害羞」，後面說有人停下來聽他就不彈了。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的個性。
offer + 人 + 物「拿某物給某人」，offered him a bottle of water「拿一瓶水給他」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
suggest that he (should) practice「建議他練習」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
raise one's hand「舉手」，舉手投票贊成。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、tested（測試）接 their hands 都說不通。

passages.zh: 上個月，有一家人搬進我們隔壁的公寓。他們有個兒子叫 Ray，年紀和我差不多。每天傍晚，他都一個人坐在公園的角落彈吉他。他彈得很好，但非常害羞，只要有人停下來聽，他就不彈了。有一天傍晚，我坐到他旁邊，拿了一瓶冰水給他。我們開始聊天，我才知道他想加入我們學校的樂團，但不敢在別人面前唱歌。因為我會打鼓，我建議他先跟我一起練習。兩個星期裡，我們每天一起練。後來我們一起去找樂團老師。Ray 唱完歌時，所有團員都舉手投贊成票。現在他是我們的主唱了！

passages.title: 八百公尺跑步測驗
passages.text: Next Monday, our class will have a running {1}. Everyone has to run 800 meters in less than five minutes. I'm not good at running, so I was very worried. My older brother {2} that I practice with him every evening. For a week, we ran around the park near our home. He also told me to eat a banana before running, because bananas give the body quick {3}. On the morning of the test, my mom {4} me up at six and made me a big breakfast. At school, I ran as fast as I could. In the last 100 meters, I wanted to stop, but my classmates cheered for me. I finished in four minutes and fifty seconds! I felt so proud that I {5} both arms in the air. "Thanks, big brother," I said to myself.

blanks.why: a running test「跑步測驗」，後面說每個人都要跑 800 公尺。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、garbage（垃圾）都不能和 running 組成要「舉行」的活動。
suggest that I (should) practice「建議我練習」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句表示建議。
give the body energy「給身體能量」，香蕉能很快補充體力。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、mistake（錯誤）都不是香蕉能給身體的東西。
wake + 人 + up「叫醒某人」，woke 是 wake 的過去式。suggested、explained、counted 都不能和 me up 搭配。
raise both arms「舉起雙臂」，表示開心。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、explained（解釋）接 both arms in the air 都說不通。

passages.zh: 下星期一，我們班要考跑步測驗，每個人都必須在五分鐘內跑完 800 公尺。我不擅長跑步，所以非常擔心。哥哥建議我每天傍晚跟他一起練習。整整一個星期，我們都在家附近的公園跑步。他還叫我跑步前吃一根香蕉，因為香蕉能很快給身體能量。測驗當天早上，媽媽六點就把我叫醒，還幫我做了一頓豐盛的早餐。到了學校，我拚命地跑。最後 100 公尺時我好想停下來，但同學們都在幫我加油。我跑出了四分五十秒！我驕傲得把雙臂高高舉起。「謝了，老哥。」我在心裡對自己說。

passages.title: 穿成一顆球的早晨
passages.text: Last week, a cold wave hit Taiwan. On Tuesday morning, it was only eight degrees in Taipei. When my alarm rang, I didn't want to leave my warm bed, so I stayed under my {1} blanket for ten more minutes. Then Dad came in and {2} me up. "Hurry, or you'll be late," he said. I put on two sweaters, a {3} coat, and a wool hat. When I looked in the mirror, I looked like a big ball! At the bus stop, everyone else looked the same, so I didn't feel embarrassed. At school, our teacher {4} us hot ginger tea. "Cold weather uses a lot of your body's {5}, so eat well and drink something warm," she said. By lunchtime, the sun came out, and I had to take off my sweaters one by one.

blanks.why: a thick blanket「厚厚的毯子」，冷天躲在裡面很溫暖。shy（害羞的）、honest（誠實的）、hungry（餓的）都不能形容毯子。
wake + 人 + up「叫醒某人」，woke 是過去式。suggested、explained、hated 都不能和 me up 搭配。
a thick coat「厚外套」，寒流來要穿得暖。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、hungry（餓的）都不能形容外套。
offer + 人 + 物「拿某物給某人」，offered us hot ginger tea「給我們熱薑茶」。woke、suggested、raised 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
the body's energy「身體的能量」，天冷身體會消耗很多能量。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、test（測驗）都不能被天氣「用掉」。

passages.zh: 上星期，寒流來襲台灣。星期二早上，台北只有八度。鬧鐘響的時候，我不想離開溫暖的床，所以又在厚厚的毯子下多躺了十分鐘。接著爸爸走進來把我叫醒。「快點，不然你會遲到。」他說。我穿了兩件毛衣、一件厚外套，還戴了一頂羊毛帽。我照鏡子時，看起來就像一顆大球！到了公車站，其他人看起來都一樣，所以我一點也不覺得尷尬。到了學校，老師請我們喝熱薑茶。「冷天氣會用掉身體很多能量，所以要吃飽，也要喝點熱的。」她說。到了午餐時間，太陽出來了，我只好把毛衣一件一件脫掉。

passages.title: 禮堂角落的舊鋼琴
passages.text: There is an old piano in a {1} of our school hall. Nobody plays it, and it is covered with dust. One day after school, I heard beautiful music coming from the hall. I looked in and saw Annie, a quiet girl from my class, playing the piano. She was so {2} that she stopped as soon as she saw me. "Please don't stop," I said. "It's wonderful." Later, I told our music teacher about it. She {3} that Annie play at the school's Christmas party. Annie was nervous, but she agreed. For a month, she practiced every day. On the night of the party, the hall was full. When Annie finished her last song, everyone stood up and clapped. Some students even {4} their phones high to take videos. After the party, the principal {5} to have the old piano fixed.

blanks.why: in a corner of our school hall「在禮堂的一個角落」。energy（精力）、headache（頭痛）、test（測驗）都不能表示地點。
so shy that she stopped「害羞到一看到我就停下來」。thick（厚的）、empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）都不能形容人的個性。
suggest that Annie (should) play「建議 Annie 表演」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
raise their phones high「把手機舉高」錄影。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、explained（解釋）接 their phones high 都說不通。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to have the piano fixed「主動說要找人修鋼琴」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to + 動詞表示主動提議。

passages.zh: 我們學校禮堂的角落有一台舊鋼琴，沒有人彈，上面積滿了灰塵。有一天放學後，我聽到禮堂傳來美妙的音樂。我往裡面看，看到班上一個安靜的女生 Annie 正在彈鋼琴。她害羞到一看到我就停了下來。「拜託不要停，」我說，「太好聽了。」後來我把這件事告訴音樂老師。她建議 Annie 在學校的聖誕晚會上表演。Annie 很緊張，但還是答應了。一整個月，她每天都在練習。晚會那天晚上，禮堂坐滿了人。Annie 彈完最後一首曲子時，大家都站起來鼓掌，有些學生甚至把手機舉高錄影。晚會結束後，校長主動說要找人把那台舊鋼琴修好。

passages.title: 為收容所的狗募款
passages.text: Our school is near an animal shelter. It takes care of over fifty dogs, but it doesn't have enough money for food. Last month, our class decided to {1} money for it. At the class meeting, Jenny {2} selling cookies at the school festival. Everyone agreed. That weekend, we baked cookies at Jenny's house. Some of them were too {3} and hard, but they still tasted good. At the festival, we put our table at a busy {4} near the school gate. Many parents bought our cookies. One old man even {5} to pay double. "My dog came from that shelter," he said with a smile. In the end, we raised 8,000 dollars. When we took the money to the shelter, the dogs barked happily, as if they were saying thank you.

blanks.why: raise money「募款」。wake（叫醒）、suggest（建議）、test（測試）接 money for it 都說不通。
suggest + V-ing「建議做…」，suggested selling cookies「建議賣餅乾」。woke、raised、tested 接 selling cookies 都說不通。
too thick and hard「太厚又太硬」，形容餅乾。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容餅乾。
a busy corner「熱鬧的轉角」，人多好擺攤。energy、headache、test 都不能表示擺攤的地點。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to pay double「主動說要付兩倍的錢」。woke、tested、copied 都不能接 to pay 表示主動提議。

passages.zh: 我們學校附近有一間動物收容所，照顧五十多隻狗，但沒有足夠的錢買飼料。上個月，我們班決定幫它募款。班會時，Jenny 建議在園遊會上賣餅乾，大家都同意。那個週末，我們在 Jenny 家烤餅乾，有些烤得太厚又太硬，但吃起來還是很好吃。園遊會那天，我們把攤位擺在校門口附近一個熱鬧的轉角，很多家長都來買。有一位老先生甚至主動說要付兩倍的錢。「我的狗就是從那間收容所領養的。」他笑著說。最後，我們募到了八千元。我們把錢送到收容所時，狗狗們開心地叫著，好像在說謝謝。

passages.title: 三個鬧鐘
passages.text: My brother Ben is the hardest person in the world to {1} up in the morning. Last week, he bought three alarm clocks and put them in different {2} of his room. "Now I'll have to get out of bed to turn them off," he said proudly. Monday morning was the first {3} of his plan. At six o'clock, the first clock rang. Ben turned it off and went back to sleep. The second one rang at 6:10, and he threw a pillow at it. The third one was under his bed. It rang so loudly that it gave the whole family a {4}, but Ben still didn't move. In the end, Mom came in with a glass of cold water. That {5} him up right away. Now Ben has only one alarm clock: Mom.

blanks.why: wake up「醒來；叫醒」，最難叫醒的人。offer、test、suggest 都不能和 up 組成「叫醒」的意思。
in different corners of his room「放在房間不同的角落」，才必須下床去關。energies、headaches、tests 都不能表示房間裡的位置。
the first test of his plan「他計畫的第一次考驗」。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、energy（精力）都不能和 of his plan 搭配。
give someone a headache「讓某人頭痛」，鬧鐘太吵讓全家頭痛。corner、test、garbage 放進去都說不通。
wake + 人 + up「把某人叫醒」，woke 是過去式，冷水把他弄醒。offered、suggested、explained 都不能和 him up 搭配。

passages.zh: 我哥哥 Ben 是全世界早上最難叫醒的人。上星期，他買了三個鬧鐘，放在房間不同的角落。「這樣我就得下床去關掉它們了。」他得意地說。星期一早上是他這個計畫的第一次考驗。六點，第一個鬧鐘響了，Ben 把它關掉又睡回去。第二個在六點十分響起，他拿枕頭丟它。第三個放在床底下，響得超大聲，吵得全家人都頭痛，但 Ben 還是一動也不動。最後，媽媽端著一杯冷水走進來，馬上就把他弄醒了。現在 Ben 只剩一個鬧鐘：媽媽。

passages.title: 夢裡的寶可夢對戰
passages.text: In my dream last night, I was a Pokémon trainer, and my partner was Pikachu. We were in a big battle against a giant dragon. Pikachu used all its {1} to attack, but the dragon was too strong. Soon, Pikachu was too tired to fight, and I didn't know what to do. Then a little girl came out from behind a tree. She {2} me a basket of red berries. "These can make Pokémon strong again," she said in a small voice. She was so {3} that she ran back behind the tree right after that. I gave the berries to Pikachu, and its cheeks began to glow. Pikachu {4} its tail high and shot a huge lightning bolt at the dragon. We won! Just as I wanted to thank the girl, my mom {5} me up. "You'll be late for school!" she said.

blanks.why: use all its energy「用盡全部力氣」去攻擊。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、test（測驗）都不能拿來攻擊。
offer + 人 + 物「拿某物給某人」，offered me a basket of berries「拿一籃莓果給我」。woke、raised、suggested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
so shy that she ran back「害羞到馬上跑回樹後」。thick（厚的）、national（國家的）、wet（濕的）都不能說明她為什麼跑走。
raise its tail「把尾巴舉起來」。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、explained（解釋）接 its tail 都說不通。
wake + 人 + up「叫醒某人」，媽媽把我叫醒，原來是一場夢。suggested、explained、counted 都不能和 me up 搭配。

passages.zh: 昨晚我夢到自己是寶可夢訓練師，夥伴是皮卡丘。我們正和一隻巨龍大戰。皮卡丘用盡全身力氣攻擊，但巨龍太強了，皮卡丘很快就累得打不動，我也不知道該怎麼辦。這時，一個小女孩從樹後面走出來，拿了一籃紅色莓果給我。「這些可以讓寶可夢恢復力量。」她小聲地說。她害羞到說完馬上又跑回樹後面。我把莓果給皮卡丘吃，牠的臉頰開始發光。皮卡丘把尾巴高高舉起，對巨龍射出一道超大的閃電。我們贏了！我正想跟女孩道謝時，媽媽把我叫醒了。「你上學要遲到了！」她說。

passages.title: 愛喝咖啡的爸爸
passages.text: My dad works long hours at a computer company. Every morning, he drinks two cups of coffee because he says it gives him {1}. Last month, he started drinking four cups a day. Then he couldn't sleep well at night, and he often had {2}. One night, he {3} up at three and couldn't fall asleep again. The next day, Mom {4} that he drink green tea instead of coffee in the afternoon. Dad didn't like the idea at first, but he tried it. My little sister helped, too. On weekends, every time Dad walked to the coffee machine, she {5} a sign that said "NO MORE COFFEE, DAD!" We all laughed, and Dad laughed the hardest. After two weeks, he slept much better, and his headaches went away.

blanks.why: give someone energy「讓某人有精神」。corner（角落）、garbage（垃圾）、sentence（句子）都不是咖啡能給人的東西。
have headaches「頭痛」，喝太多咖啡睡不好就常頭痛。corners、tests、energies 放進去都說不通。
wake up「醒來」，woke 是過去式，他半夜三點醒來。tested、offered、suggested 都不能和 up 組成「醒來」的意思。
suggest that he (should) drink「建議他喝」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
raise a sign「舉起一個牌子」。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、tested（測試）接 a sign that said… 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我爸爸在一家電腦公司上班，工作時間很長。每天早上他都喝兩杯咖啡，因為他說咖啡讓他有精神。上個月，他開始一天喝四杯。結果他晚上睡不好，還常常頭痛。有一天晚上，他半夜三點醒來，就再也睡不著了。隔天，媽媽建議他下午改喝綠茶，不要喝咖啡。爸爸一開始不喜歡這個主意，但還是試了。我妹妹也來幫忙：週末只要爸爸一走向咖啡機，她就舉起一個寫著「爸爸，不准再喝咖啡！」的牌子。我們全都笑了，爸爸笑得最大聲。兩個星期後，他睡得好多了，頭痛也不見了。

passages.title: 九份霧中迷路
passages.text: Last winter, my family visited Jiufen. When we got there, a {1} fog covered the whole mountain. We could only see a few meters ahead. After dinner, I went out to buy taro balls, but on the way back, I turned the wrong {2} and got lost. All the narrow streets looked the same in the fog. My phone had no battery, and I started to feel scared. Then an old man selling tea {3} to help me. He asked me the name of our hotel and walked me there. On the way, he told me stories about the old gold mines. When we arrived, my parents were very worried. Mom {4} that we give the man some money, but he said no. Before he left, he said, "Next time, {5} up early. Jiufen is most beautiful in the morning."

blanks.why: a thick fog「濃霧」，後面說只看得到前方幾公尺。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、hungry（餓的）都不能形容霧。
turn the wrong corner「轉錯彎」，所以迷路了。energy、headache、test 都不能「轉」。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to help me「主動說要幫我」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to help 表示主動提議。
suggest that we (should) give「建議我們給」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
wake up early「早點起床」。raise、offer、test 都不能和 up 組成「起床」的意思。

passages.zh: 去年冬天，我們全家去九份玩。我們到的時候，濃霧籠罩了整座山，只看得到前方幾公尺。晚餐後，我出去買芋圓，但回來的路上轉錯了彎，迷路了。在霧裡，每一條窄窄的街道看起來都一樣。我的手機沒電了，我開始害怕。這時，一位賣茶的老先生主動說要幫我。他問了我們旅館的名字，然後陪我走回去。路上，他跟我講了許多老金礦的故事。我們到旅館時，爸媽非常擔心。媽媽建議給老先生一些錢，但他不肯收。離開前他說：「下次早點起床，九份早上最漂亮。」

passages.title: 模擬考前的頭痛
passages.text: The first mock exam is next week, so everyone in our class is busy. My friend Sam studied until midnight every night. On Thursday, he got a bad {1} and had to go to the nurse's office. The nurse told him that his body needed rest. She {2} that he sleep earlier and take short breaks while studying. After school, I {3} to study with him at the library. We made a study plan together and stopped every forty minutes to walk around. We also asked each other questions, just like a real {4}. On Monday, the day of the mock exam, Sam had a lot of {5}. He finished every question and still had time to check his answers. "Sleep is better than coffee," he told me with a smile.

blanks.why: get a bad headache「頭痛得很厲害」，所以去保健室。corner（角落）、energy（精力）、garbage（垃圾）放進去都說不通。
suggest that he (should) sleep「建議他早點睡」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to study with him「主動說要陪他讀書」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to study 表示主動提議。
just like a real test「就像真的考試一樣」互相問問題。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、energy（精力）都不能用問問題來模仿。
have a lot of energy「很有精神」，所以每題都寫完。corner、sentence、smoke 放進去都說不通。

passages.zh: 第一次模擬考就在下星期，班上每個人都很忙。我的朋友 Sam 每天晚上都讀到半夜。星期四，他頭痛得很厲害，只好去保健室。護理師告訴他，他的身體需要休息，建議他早點睡，讀書時也要短暫休息一下。放學後，我主動說要陪他去圖書館讀書。我們一起訂了讀書計畫，每讀四十分鐘就起來走一走。我們也互相出題，就像真的考試一樣。星期一模擬考那天，Sam 精神很好，每一題都寫完了，還有時間檢查答案。「睡覺比咖啡有用。」他笑著對我說。

passages.title: 躲在沙發下的 Kiwi
passages.text: We adopted a cat from the shelter last month. Her name is Kiwi. On her first day, she was so {1} that she hid under the sofa. For three days, she stayed in a dark {2} of the living room and only came out at night to eat. My sister wanted to pull her out, but Mom said, "Give her time." She {3} putting a box with a soft towel near the corner. On the fourth night, I sat on the floor quietly and {4} her a piece of chicken. Kiwi looked at me for a long time. Then, slowly, she came over and ate it. The next morning, something surprised me. Kiwi jumped onto my bed and {5} me up by licking my face! Now she follows me everywhere, even into the bathroom.

blanks.why: so shy that she hid「害羞到躲起來」。thick（厚的）、sharp（尖銳的）、wooden（木製的）都不能說明牠為什麼躲起來。
in a dark corner「在陰暗的角落」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
suggest + V-ing「建議做…」，suggested putting a box「建議放一個箱子」。woke、raised、tested 接 putting a box 都說不通。
offer + 人 + 物「拿某物給某人」，offered her a piece of chicken「拿一塊雞肉給牠」。woke、raised、suggested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
wake + 人 + up「叫醒某人」，牠舔我的臉把我叫醒。offered、suggested、tested 都不能和 me up 搭配。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們從收容所領養了一隻貓，名字叫 Kiwi。第一天，牠害羞到躲在沙發底下。整整三天，牠都待在客廳陰暗的角落，只有晚上才出來吃東西。我妹妹想把牠拉出來，但媽媽說：「給牠一點時間。」她建議在那個角落旁邊放一個鋪著軟毛巾的箱子。第四天晚上，我安靜地坐在地上，拿一塊雞肉給牠。Kiwi 盯著我看了很久，然後慢慢走過來把雞肉吃掉。隔天早上，一件事讓我很驚喜：Kiwi 跳上我的床，舔我的臉把我叫醒！現在牠走到哪裡都跟著我，連我進浴室也跟。

passages.title: 班級合唱比賽
passages.text: Our class joined the school singing contest this year. At first, many of us were too {1} to sing loudly. Our music teacher said, "If you sing like that, the judges won't hear you!" She {2} that we practice in the park, where nobody knew us. So every morning before class, we met under a big tree. Some of us were still sleepy, so our class leader, Ivy, played fast music to {3} us up. Slowly, our voices became stronger and full of {4}. On the day of the contest, we stood on the stage. When our teacher {5} her hands, we began to sing. We didn't win first place, but we got the "Best Spirit" prize. Our teacher said she was proud of us, and we were proud of ourselves, too.

blanks.why: too shy to sing loudly「太害羞而不敢大聲唱」。thick（厚的）、empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）都不能形容人不敢唱歌。
suggest that we (should) practice「建議我們練習」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
wake + 人 + up「讓某人清醒」，放快歌讓還想睡的同學清醒。offer、suggest、test 都不能和 us up 搭配。
full of energy「充滿活力」，形容歌聲。corner、headache、garbage 放進去都說不通。
raise her hands「舉起雙手」，指揮開始。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、explained（解釋）接 her hands 都說不通。

passages.zh: 今年我們班參加了學校的合唱比賽。一開始，很多人都太害羞，不敢大聲唱。音樂老師說：「你們這樣唱，評審會聽不到！」她建議我們去沒人認識我們的公園練習。於是每天早上上課前，我們都在一棵大樹下集合。有些人還很想睡，所以班長 Ivy 就放快歌讓大家清醒。慢慢地，我們的歌聲越來越大，也充滿了活力。比賽那天，我們站上舞台。老師一舉起雙手，我們就開始唱。我們沒有得到第一名，但拿到了「最佳精神獎」。老師說她以我們為榮，我們也為自己感到驕傲。

passages.title: 奶奶的厚相簿
passages.text: Every Lunar New Year, my grandma takes out an old photo album. It is so {1} that she needs both hands to carry it. This year, I sat next to her and looked at the photos with her. In one black-and-white picture, a young man was standing in the {2}, looking at the ground. "Who is that?" I asked. "That's your grandpa," Grandma said. "He was very {3}. At a friend's party, he didn't say a word to me all night." "Then how did you two get married?" I asked. Grandma laughed. "At the end of the party, he {4} to walk me home. Then it took him three months to ask me out." I {5} that we put the photos on the computer so the whole family could see them. Grandma agreed, but she said she would keep the album, too.

blanks.why: so thick that she needs both hands「厚到要用雙手才拿得動」。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、hungry（餓的）都不能形容相簿。
standing in the corner「站在角落」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示照片中的位置。
very shy「很害羞」，後面說他整晚沒跟奶奶說一句話。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）都不能形容人的個性。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to walk me home「主動說要送我回家」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to walk 表示主動提議。
suggest that we (should) put「建議我們把…」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 每年農曆新年，奶奶都會拿出一本舊相簿。它厚到奶奶要用雙手才拿得動。今年，我坐在她旁邊陪她一起看照片。有一張黑白照片裡，一個年輕人站在角落，眼睛看著地上。「那是誰？」我問。「那是你爺爺，」奶奶說，「他很害羞。在朋友的派對上，他整晚沒跟我說一句話。」「那你們兩個是怎麼結婚的？」我問。奶奶笑了：「派對結束時，他主動說要送我回家。然後他又花了三個月才約我出去。」我建議把照片存到電腦裡，讓全家人都看得到。奶奶答應了，但她說相簿她也要留著。

passages.title: 士林夜市的大雞排
passages.text: On a busy street {1} in Shilin Night Market, there is a small fried chicken stand. The owner, Uncle Hsu, is famous for his {2} chicken cutlets. They are as big as my face! Last Saturday, I waited in line there with my cousin from Canada. She was a little {3} and didn't speak much Chinese, so I ordered for her. When Uncle Hsu heard her speak English, he smiled and {4} her a free cup of iced tea. "Welcome to Taiwan!" he said in English. My cousin took one bite of the chicken, and her eyes opened wide. "This is the best food I've ever eaten," she said. Before we left, she {5} her cup to Uncle Hsu and said "xie xie" in Chinese. Everyone in the line laughed and clapped.

blanks.why: a street corner「街角」，攤子在熱鬧的街角。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
thick chicken cutlets「厚厚的雞排」，後面說跟我的臉一樣大。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容食物。
a little shy「有點害羞」，又不太會說中文，所以我幫她點餐。thick（厚的）、empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）都不能形容人的個性。
offer + 人 + 物「請某人某物」，offered her a free cup of iced tea「請她喝一杯免費冰茶」。woke、raised、suggested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
raise her cup「舉起杯子」向老闆致意。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、explained（解釋）接 her cup to Uncle Hsu 都說不通。

passages.zh: 士林夜市一個熱鬧的街角有一家小小的炸雞排攤。老闆許伯伯以厚厚的雞排出名，一片跟我的臉一樣大！上星期六，我陪從加拿大來的表姊在那裡排隊。她有點害羞，又不太會說中文，所以我幫她點餐。許伯伯聽到她說英文，就笑著請她喝一杯免費的冰茶。「歡迎來台灣！」他用英文說。表姊咬了一口雞排，眼睛瞪得好大。「這是我吃過最好吃的東西。」她說。離開前，她向許伯伯舉起杯子，用中文說「謝謝」。排隊的人都笑著拍起手來。

passages.title: 巫師學校的飛行測驗
passages.text: At Moonlight School of Magic, every first-year student has to take a flying {1} on a broom. Leo was the {2} boy in his class, and he was also afraid of high places. The night before the test, he was so worried that he couldn't sleep, and he got a terrible {3}. His roommate, Finn, {4} him a cup of hot magic tea. "Drink this. It will give you {5} and courage," Finn said. Leo drank it all and fell asleep. The next morning, he got on his broom and flew higher and higher. He even flew around the school tower three times! When he landed, everyone cheered. Later, Finn told him the truth: the "magic tea" was just normal tea with honey. "The courage was yours all along," Finn said with a laugh.

blanks.why: take a flying test「參加飛行測驗」。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、garbage（垃圾）都不能和 take a flying ___ 搭配成考試。
the shyest boy「最害羞的男孩」。thickest（最厚的）、emptiest（最空的）、cheapest（最便宜的）都不能形容人的個性。
get a terrible headache「頭痛得很厲害」，因為太擔心睡不著。corner、energy、garbage 放進去都說不通。
offer + 人 + 物「拿某物給某人」，offered him a cup of tea「拿一杯茶給他」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
give you energy and courage「給你精神和勇氣」。corner（角落）、garbage（垃圾）、sentence（句子）都不是茶能給人的東西。

passages.zh: 在月光魔法學校，每個一年級新生都要騎掃帚參加飛行測驗。Leo 是班上最害羞的男生，而且還怕高。測驗前一晚，他擔心得睡不著，頭痛得很厲害。他的室友 Finn 拿了一杯熱熱的魔法茶給他。「喝了吧，它會給你精神和勇氣。」Finn 說。Leo 一口喝光就睡著了。隔天早上，他騎上掃帚，越飛越高，甚至繞著學校的高塔飛了三圈！他降落時，大家都歡呼起來。後來 Finn 跟他說了實話：那杯「魔法茶」只是加了蜂蜜的普通茶。「勇氣一直都是你自己的。」Finn 笑著說。

passages.title: 太空營的體能測驗
passages.text: Lin Yu-an's dream is to become an astronaut. Last summer, she joined a space camp for teenagers. Every morning, the coaches {1} the students up at five. Then they had to take many different {2}. In one of them, students sat in a machine that turned around very fast. Many of them felt sick and got {3}. Yu-an felt tired, too, but she still had a lot of {4}. In the last activity, students had to build a small rocket in teams of four. Yu-an's teammates were {5} and didn't talk much, so she shared her ideas first. Soon, everyone started to talk and laugh. Their rocket flew the highest of all. On the last day, a real astronaut gave Yu-an a small badge. "Space needs people like you," he said.

blanks.why: wake + 人 + up「叫醒某人」，woke 是過去式。offered、suggested、tested 都不能和 the students up 搭配。
take tests「接受測驗」。corners（角落）、headaches（頭痛）、energies（精力）都不能「參加」。
got headaches「頭痛」，坐高速旋轉的機器會頭暈頭痛。corners、tests、garbage 放進去都說不通。
have a lot of energy「還很有精神」，與前面的 tired 對比。corner、garbage、sentence 放進去都說不通。
shy and didn't talk much「害羞、話不多」，所以她先分享想法。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容隊友的個性。

passages.zh: 林語安的夢想是當太空人。去年夏天，她參加了一個青少年太空營。每天早上，教練五點就把學員叫醒，接著大家要接受許多不同的測驗。其中一項，學員要坐進一台轉得非常快的機器，很多人都覺得想吐、頭痛。語安也很累，但她還是很有精神。最後一個活動，學員要四人一組做一支小火箭。語安的隊友都很害羞，話不多，所以她先分享自己的想法。很快地，大家開始有說有笑。他們的火箭飛得最高。最後一天，一位真正的太空人送給語安一枚小徽章。「太空需要像妳這樣的人。」他說。

passages.title: 叫醒熊大哥
passages.text: In a quiet forest, a big brown bear slept in a cave all winter. When spring came, all the animals wanted him to {1} up, because he always told the funniest stories. The rabbit {2} singing a song outside the cave. The birds sang as loudly as they could, but the bear didn't move. Then the squirrel walked into the dark cave by himself. He was very {3}, but he wanted to help his friends. Inside, he found the bear sleeping in a {4} under a {5} pile of leaves. The squirrel had an idea. He put a jar of honey right next to the bear's nose. Slowly, the bear's nose moved. Then his eyes opened. "Honey!" he shouted. All the animals laughed and cheered. "The best way to wake a bear," said the squirrel, "is with his favorite food."

blanks.why: wake up「醒來」，動物們希望熊醒來。raise、offer、test 都不能和 up 組成「醒來」的意思。
suggest + V-ing「建議做…」，suggested singing a song「建議唱歌」。woke、raised、tested 接 singing a song 都說不通。
very shy「很害羞」，但還是想幫朋友，所以用 but。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）都不能形容松鼠的個性。
in a corner「在角落」，熊睡在洞穴的角落。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
a thick pile of leaves「厚厚一堆葉子」。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容葉子堆。

passages.zh: 在一座安靜的森林裡，一隻大棕熊在洞穴裡睡了一整個冬天。春天來了，所有動物都希望牠醒來，因為牠總是講最好笑的故事。兔子建議在洞口唱歌。鳥兒們用最大的聲音唱，但熊動也不動。這時，松鼠自己走進黑漆漆的洞穴裡。牠很害羞，但牠想幫朋友。在洞裡，牠發現熊睡在角落一堆厚厚的葉子下面。松鼠想到一個主意，牠把一罐蜂蜜放在熊的鼻子旁邊。慢慢地，熊的鼻子動了，接著眼睛也張開了。「蜂蜜！」牠大叫。所有動物都笑著歡呼起來。「叫醒熊最好的方法，」松鼠說，「就是用牠最愛的食物。」

passages.title: 班上的意見箱
passages.text: Last month, our teacher put a small box in the {1} of our classroom. "If you have any ideas to make our class better, write them down and put them in the box," she said. Many students were too {2} to speak in front of everyone, so the box was a great idea. On Friday, she opened it and read the notes aloud. One student {3} having ten minutes of game time after the weekly {4}. Another student wrote that the classroom was too hot in the afternoon and asked for one more fan. Our teacher said we could vote on each idea. We voted by {5} our hands. Both ideas won. Now, every Friday after the quiz, we play a word game, and the classroom is much cooler, too. Our teacher says the box is the best "classmate" we have.

blanks.why: in the corner of our classroom「在教室的角落」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
too shy to speak「太害羞而不敢說話」。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容學生不敢發言。
suggest + V-ing「建議做…」，suggested having game time「建議有遊戲時間」。woke、raised、tested 接 having ten minutes of game time 都說不通。
the weekly test「每週的小考」，後面也說 after the quiz。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、energy（精力）都不是每週固定的活動。
vote by raising our hands「舉手表決」，by 後面接 V-ing。waking、testing、copying 接 our hands 都說不通。

passages.zh: 上個月，老師在教室的角落放了一個小箱子。「如果你們有任何讓班上更好的點子，就寫下來放進箱子裡。」她說。很多同學太害羞，不敢在大家面前發言，所以這個箱子是個很棒的主意。星期五，她打開箱子，把紙條唸出來。有一位同學建議每週小考後有十分鐘的遊戲時間。另一位同學寫說下午教室太熱，希望多一台電風扇。老師說每個點子都可以表決。我們舉手表決，兩個點子都通過了。現在每個星期五小考完，我們都會玩單字遊戲，教室也涼快多了。老師說，這個箱子是我們最棒的「同學」。

passages.title: 陽台上的小雞
passages.text: My little sister brought home two baby chicks from her school science class. She wanted to {1} them at home. Mom wasn't happy at first, but she finally agreed. We put the chicks in a box with a {2} towel and kept it in a {3} of the balcony. Every morning, the chicks {4} us up with their loud "peep, peep." My sister fed them and cleaned the box every day. The chicks grew very fast. After two months, they were too big for the box, and our neighbors began to complain about the noise. Dad {5} that we give them to Grandpa, who has a farm in Yilan. My sister cried, but she agreed in the end. Now we visit Grandpa's farm every month. The chickens still run to my sister when she calls them.

blanks.why: raise them「養牠們」，raise 有「飼養、養育」的意思。wake（叫醒）、suggest（建議）、explain（解釋）接 them at home 都說不通。
a thick towel「厚毛巾」，讓小雞保暖。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容毛巾。
in a corner of the balcony「在陽台的一個角落」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
wake + 人 + up「把某人吵醒」，小雞每天早上叫醒我們。offered、suggested、explained 都不能和 us up 搭配。
suggest that we (should) give「建議我們把…送給」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 我妹妹從學校的自然課帶回兩隻小雞，她想在家裡養牠們。媽媽一開始不太高興，但最後還是答應了。我們把小雞放進一個鋪著厚毛巾的箱子，放在陽台的角落。每天早上，小雞都用響亮的「啾啾」聲把我們吵醒。妹妹每天餵牠們、清箱子。小雞長得很快，兩個月後，牠們已經大到箱子裝不下，鄰居也開始抱怨太吵。爸爸建議把牠們送給在宜蘭有農場的爺爺。妹妹哭了，但最後還是答應了。現在我們每個月都去爺爺的農場，妹妹一叫，那兩隻雞還是會跑過來。

passages.title: 我的第一副眼鏡
passages.text: Every year, our school gives students an eye {1}. This year, I couldn't read the small letters on the last line. The nurse told me to come closer, but I still couldn't read them. "You might need glasses," she said. I also remembered that I often got {2} when I read for a long time. That weekend, Mom took me to see an eye doctor. He {3} that I use my phone less and look at green trees more often. He also {4} me a few frames to try on. I chose blue ones. When I put on my new glasses, the world became so clear! I could see every leaf on the trees. At first, I was too {5} to wear them at school, but my friends said they looked cool. Now I wear them every day.

blanks.why: an eye test「視力檢查」。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、energy（精力）都不能和 eye 組成學校給學生做的檢查。
got headaches「頭痛」，看不清楚又看書太久會頭痛。corners、energies、tests 放進去都說不通。
suggest that I (should) use「建議我少用手機」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
offer + 人 + 物「拿某物給某人」，offered me a few frames「拿幾副鏡框給我試戴」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
too shy to wear them「太害羞而不敢戴」。thick（厚的）、empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）都不能形容人不敢做某事。

passages.zh: 我們學校每年都會幫學生做視力檢查。今年，我看不清楚最後一行的小字母。護理師叫我走近一點，但我還是看不清楚。「你可能需要戴眼鏡了。」她說。我也想起自己看書看久了常常會頭痛。那個週末，媽媽帶我去看眼科醫生。他建議我少用手機，多看綠色的樹。他還拿了幾副鏡框給我試戴，我選了藍色的。戴上新眼鏡的那一刻，世界變得好清楚！我能看見樹上的每一片葉子。一開始我太害羞，不敢在學校戴，但朋友們都說很好看。現在我每天都戴著它。

passages.title: 地震演練
passages.text: Last Thursday, our school had an earthquake drill. At ten o'clock, the alarm rang loudly. It was only a {1}, but everyone had to act like it was real. Our teacher shouted, "Get under your desks!" We hid under our desks and held the legs tightly. Kevin's desk was too small for him, so he sat next to a wall and covered his head with a {2} book. Then we walked quickly to the playground. Afterward, our teacher {3} that every family prepare an emergency bag at home. "Put water, food, and a flashlight in it," she said. That night, I told my parents about it. Dad {4} to buy the things we needed, and Mom found an old backpack. We packed the bag together and put it in a {5} of the living room, near the front door.

blanks.why: only a test「只是演練（測試）」，不是真的地震。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、garbage（垃圾）放進去都說不通。
a thick book「厚厚的書」，可以保護頭部。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容書。
suggest that every family (should) prepare「建議每個家庭準備」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to buy「主動說要去買」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to buy 表示主動提議。
in a corner of the living room「在客廳的一個角落」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示放東西的地點。

passages.zh: 上星期四，我們學校舉行地震演練。十點整，警報大聲響起。雖然只是演練，但大家都要當作真的一樣。老師大喊：「躲到桌子底下！」我們躲在桌子下，緊緊抓住桌腳。Kevin 的桌子對他來說太小了，所以他坐在牆邊，用一本厚厚的書蓋住頭。接著我們快步走到操場。演練結束後，老師建議每個家庭都在家裡準備一個緊急避難包。「裡面要放水、食物和手電筒。」她說。那天晚上，我把這件事告訴爸媽。爸爸主動說要去買需要的東西，媽媽找出一個舊背包。我們一起把包包裝好，放在客廳靠近大門的角落。

passages.title: 爺爺的厚字典
passages.text: Grandpa gave me his old English dictionary. It was so {1} that it weighed almost two kilograms. At first, I put it in a {2} of my desk and never opened it. I always used my phone to look up words. One day, our English teacher {3} that we use paper dictionaries. "When you look for one word, you'll find many others," she said. I decided to try it. While I was looking for the word "headache," I found "headline," "headphones," and "head start." It was fun! Before the vocabulary {4} the next week, I read ten pages every night. I got 100 on the test. Grandpa was so happy that he {5} to give me his old English storybooks, too. Now the dictionary isn't in the corner anymore. It is always open on my desk.

blanks.why: so thick that it weighed almost two kilograms「厚到快兩公斤重」。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、hungry（餓的）都不能形容字典。
in a corner of my desk「在書桌的角落」，表示擱著不用。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
suggest that we (should) use「建議我們用」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
the vocabulary test「單字測驗」，後面說考了 100 分。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、smoke（煙）都不能考出分數。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to give me…「主動說要把…送給我」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to give 表示主動提議。

passages.zh: 爺爺把他的舊英文字典送給我。它厚到將近兩公斤重。一開始，我把它擱在書桌的角落，從來沒打開過，查單字都用手機。有一天，英文老師建議我們使用紙本字典。「你找一個字的時候，會發現很多其他的字。」她說。我決定試試看。我在查 headache 這個字的時候，還看到了 headline、headphones 和 head start，好好玩！下個星期的單字測驗前，我每天晚上都讀十頁，結果考了一百分。爺爺高興到主動說要把他的舊英文故事書也送給我。現在那本字典不再待在角落了，它總是攤開在我的書桌上。

passages.title: 害羞的機器人 Beep
passages.text: In the year 2080, every family had a robot helper. Our robot, Beep, was different from the others. He was very {1}. Whenever visitors came, he hid behind the kitchen door. One night, my baby sister cried for hours. Mom and Dad were so tired that they almost fell asleep standing up. Then Beep came out of his {2} and {3} to sing her a song. His voice was soft and sweet. Soon, my sister stopped crying and fell asleep in his arms. But singing used a lot of his {4}, and his light turned red. Dad put him on the charger for the night. The next morning, Beep {5} us up with pancakes and orange juice. "Thank you, Beep," Mom said and gave him a hug. Beep's face turned pink. He was still shy, but he looked very happy.

blanks.why: very shy「很害羞」，後面說有客人來就躲起來。thick（厚的）、national（國家的）、delicious（美味的）都不能形容機器人的個性。
came out of his corner「從他的角落走出來」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示他待的地方。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to sing her a song「主動說要唱歌給她聽」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to sing 表示主動提議。
use a lot of energy「用掉很多電力（能量）」，所以燈變紅了。corner、headache、garbage 放進去都說不通。
wake + 人 + up「叫醒某人」，Beep 用早餐叫醒我們。offered、suggested、explained 都不能和 us up 搭配。

passages.zh: 在 2080 年，每個家庭都有一個機器人幫手。我們家的機器人 Beep 和別的不一樣，他非常害羞，只要有客人來，就躲到廚房門後面。有一天晚上，我的小妹妹哭了好幾個小時。爸媽累到站著都快睡著了。這時，Beep 從他的角落走出來，主動說要唱歌給她聽。他的聲音又輕又溫柔，妹妹很快就不哭了，在他懷裡睡著。可是唱歌用掉他很多電力，他的燈變成了紅色。爸爸讓他整晚充電。隔天早上，Beep 用鬆餅和柳橙汁叫醒我們。「謝謝你，Beep。」媽媽說著抱了他一下。Beep 的臉變成粉紅色。他還是很害羞，但看起來非常開心。

passages.title: 捷運上的讓座
passages.text: On my way home on the MRT, every seat was taken. At the next station, an old woman with a heavy bag got on. Nobody moved. I was standing, so I couldn't give her a seat. Then a high school boy who was sitting in the {1} seat stood up. He looked a little {2}, but he {3} her his seat. The woman smiled and thanked him. Then she took a bag of oranges out of her bag and gave him one. The boy's face turned red, and everyone around them smiled. That small action had a big {4} on me. Now, whenever I see someone who needs a seat more than I do, I {5} mine right away. Sometimes it feels a little awkward, but the smiles always make my day.

blanks.why: the corner seat「角落的座位」。energy、headache、test 都不能和 seat 組成座位的位置。
a little shy「有點害羞」，但還是讓座，所以用 but。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的樣子。
offer + 人 + 物「把某物讓給某人」，offered her his seat「把座位讓給她」。woke、raised、suggested 都不能接「人＋物」兩個受詞。
have an influence on「對…有影響」。noise（噪音）、smoke（煙）、joy（喜悅）都不能和 have a big ___ on me 搭配。
offer mine「讓出我的（座位）」，mine 指 my seat。wake（叫醒）、raise（舉起）、test（測試）接 mine 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我搭捷運回家時，所有座位都坐滿了。到了下一站，一位提著重袋子的老婆婆上了車，卻沒有人起身。我自己是站著的，沒辦法讓座給她。這時，一個坐在角落座位的高中男生站了起來。他看起來有點害羞，但還是把座位讓給了她。老婆婆笑著跟他道謝，接著從袋子裡拿出一袋橘子，給了他一顆。男生的臉紅了，周圍的人都笑了。這個小小的舉動對我影響很大。現在只要看到比我更需要座位的人，我就會馬上讓座。有時候會覺得有點尷尬，但他們的笑容總是讓我一整天都很開心。

passages.title: 沒有答案的數學題
passages.text: Last night, I spent two hours on one math question. It gave me a {1}. I tried every way I knew, but I still couldn't solve it. My dad, who is an engineer, {2} to help me. He looked at the question for ten minutes and then said, "Hmm, this is hard." Even Dad couldn't solve it! Then my sister {3} that we ask our cousin, who studies math at a university. We called her. After a few minutes, she laughed and said, "There's a mistake in the question. It has no answer!" The next day, I {4} my hand in class and told my teacher about the mistake. He checked the question and said I was right. "Good job! You found my mistake," he said. "You get five extra points on the next {5}!"

blanks.why: give someone a headache「讓某人頭痛」，算了兩小時還解不出來。corner、energy、garbage 放進去都說不通。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to help me「主動說要幫我」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to help 表示主動提議。
suggest that we (should) ask「建議我們去問」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
raise one's hand「舉手」發言。woke（叫醒）、tested（測試）、copied（抄寫）接 my hand 都說不通。
the next test「下一次考試」，加分加在考試上。corner（角落）、headache（頭痛）、energy（精力）都不能加分。

passages.zh: 昨天晚上，我花了兩個小時在一道數學題上，算得我頭都痛了。我試了所有會的方法，還是解不出來。我爸爸是工程師，他主動說要幫我。他看了題目十分鐘，然後說：「嗯，這題很難。」連爸爸都解不出來！接著姊姊建議我們去問在大學讀數學的表姊。我們打電話給她。過了幾分鐘，她笑著說：「題目出錯了，它根本沒有答案！」隔天，我在課堂上舉手，告訴老師題目有錯。他檢查了題目，說我是對的。「做得好！你找到了我的錯誤，」他說，「下次考試給你加五分！」

passages.title: 桌球的新搭檔
passages.text: Our school's table tennis team needed a new player for the doubles game. The coach chose Ken, a new student who was very {1}. He hardly talked during practice, and I didn't know how to play with him. The coach {2} that we eat lunch together every day to get to know each other. Slowly, I learned that Ken was funny and kind. We also practiced together after school every day. In the final game, we were losing 9 to 10. Then Ken hit the ball into the far {3} of the table, and the other team couldn't return it. Next, I served with all my {4} and won the point. In the end, we won the game! Ken and I {5} our paddles in the air and shouted. After that day, he was never shy around me again.

blanks.why: very shy「很害羞」，後面說練習時幾乎不說話。thick（厚的）、empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）都不能形容人的個性。
suggest that we (should) eat「建議我們一起吃」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
the far corner of the table「球桌遠處的角落」，對手接不到。energy、headache、test 都不能表示球落下的位置。
with all my energy「用盡全力」發球。corner、headache、garbage 放進去都說不通。
raise our paddles「舉起球拍」慶祝。woke（叫醒）、suggested（建議）、tested（測試）接 our paddles in the air 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我們學校的桌球隊需要一位新隊員來打雙打。教練選了 Ken，一位非常害羞的轉學生。他練習時幾乎不說話，我不知道該怎麼跟他搭配。教練建議我們每天一起吃午餐，好互相認識。慢慢地，我發現 Ken 很幽默也很善良。我們每天放學後也一起練習。決賽時，我們 9 比 10 落後。這時 Ken 把球打到球桌遠處的角落，對手接不到。接著，我用盡全力發球，又拿下一分。最後我們贏了！Ken 和我把球拍舉到空中大聲歡呼。從那天起，他在我面前再也不害羞了。

passages.title: 皮太厚的水餃
passages.text: Last Sunday, my grandma {1} that my brother and I make dumplings with her. We {2} up early and went to the market with her to buy pork and cabbage. Grandma made the filling, and we made the wrappers. But ours were too {3}, and our dumplings looked like small buns. Some of them even broke in the boiling water. My brother was sad, but Grandma laughed. "My first dumplings looked even worse," she said. At dinner, she {4} our dumplings to Grandpa first. He ate three of them slowly. Then he smiled and said, "These are the {5} dumplings I've ever eaten, but they're full of love." Everyone laughed. Next week, we're going to try again, and this time I'll make the wrappers thinner.

blanks.why: suggest that my brother and I (should) make「建議我和弟弟一起包」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
wake up early「很早起床」，woke 是過去式。offered、suggested、tested 都不能和 up 組成「起床」的意思。
too thick「太厚」，所以水餃像小包子，最後也說要做薄一點。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容餃子皮。
offer A to B「把 A 給 B（請 B 吃）」，offered our dumplings to Grandpa「先拿我們包的水餃給爺爺吃」。woke、raised、tested 都不能和 to Grandpa 搭配成「請…吃」。
the thickest dumplings「皮最厚的水餃」。shyest（最害羞的）、loneliest（最寂寞的）、hungriest（最餓的）都不能形容水餃。

passages.zh: 上星期天，奶奶提議我和弟弟跟她一起包水餃。我們很早就起床，跟她去市場買豬肉和高麗菜。奶奶做餡，我們做水餃皮。可是我們做的皮太厚了，包出來的水餃像小包子，有些在滾水裡還破掉了。弟弟很難過，奶奶卻笑了。「我第一次包的水餃更醜呢。」她說。晚餐時，她先拿我們包的水餃給爺爺吃。爺爺慢慢吃了三顆，然後笑著說：「這是我吃過皮最厚的水餃，不過裡面充滿了愛。」大家都笑了。下星期我們要再試一次，這次我會把皮做薄一點。

passages.title: 公園撿到的小貓頭鷹
passages.text: One windy evening, I found a baby owl in a {1} of the park. It had fallen from a tree and couldn't fly. I wanted to take it home and {2} it myself, but my dad said wild animals need special care. He {3} that we call the wild bird society. While we waited, I put the owl in a box with a {4} towel to keep it warm. It sat quietly and looked at me with its big round eyes. An hour later, a woman from the society came. She checked the owl carefully and said it was healthy but hungry. "In a few weeks, it will have enough {5} to fly again," she said. A month later, she sent us a video. In it, the young owl was flying back into the trees. I watched it ten times.

blanks.why: in a corner of the park「在公園的一個角落」。energy、headache、test 都不能表示地點。
raise it myself「自己養牠」，raise 有「飼養」的意思。wake（叫醒）、suggest（建議）接 it myself 說不通；arrive 是不及物動詞，後面不能接受詞。
suggest that we (should) call「建議我們打電話」。woke、raised、tested 後面都不能接 that 子句。
a thick towel「厚毛巾」，用來保暖。shy（害羞的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容毛巾。
have enough energy to fly「有足夠的力氣飛」。corner、headache、garbage 放進去都說不通。

passages.zh: 一個颳風的傍晚，我在公園的角落發現一隻小貓頭鷹。牠從樹上掉下來，不會飛。我想把牠帶回家自己養，但爸爸說野生動物需要特別的照顧。他建議我們打電話給野鳥協會。等待的時候，我把貓頭鷹放進鋪著厚毛巾的箱子裡保暖。牠安靜地坐著，用大大的圓眼睛看著我。一個小時後，協會的一位小姐來了。她仔細檢查貓頭鷹後說，牠很健康，只是肚子餓了。「再過幾個星期，牠就會有足夠的力氣再飛了。」她說。一個月後，她傳給我們一段影片，影片裡那隻年輕的貓頭鷹正飛回樹林裡。我看了十遍。

passages.title: 畢旅要去哪裡？
passages.text: Our class is planning our graduation trip, and everyone has different ideas. Andy {1} going to Kenting because he loves the beach. Ivy, who is usually {2}, said quietly that she wanted to see the mountains in Hualien. Some students wanted to go to an amusement park. To make a decision, our class leader asked us to {3} our hands to vote. In the end, the amusement park won. Ivy looked a little disappointed, so I {4} to sit with her on the roller coaster. "Maybe after graduation, we can go to Hualien together," I said, and she smiled. Our teacher reminded us that we still have to finish our final {5} before the trip. "First study hard," she said, "and then have fun!"

blanks.why: suggest + V-ing「建議做…」，suggested going to Kenting「建議去墾丁」。woke、raised、tested 接 going to Kenting 都說不通。
usually shy「平常很害羞」，所以說話很小聲。thick（厚的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的個性。
raise our hands to vote「舉手投票」。wake（叫醒）、offer（提供）、test（測試）接 our hands to vote 都說不通。
offer to + 原形動詞「主動表示要…」，offered to sit with her「主動說要跟她坐」。woke、raised、tested 都不能接 to sit 表示主動提議。
final tests「期末考」，要先考完才去畢旅。corners（角落）、headaches（頭痛）、energies（精力）都不能「完成」。

passages.zh: 我們班正在規劃畢業旅行，每個人的想法都不一樣。Andy 建議去墾丁，因為他愛海灘。平常很害羞的 Ivy 小聲地說，她想去看花蓮的山。還有些同學想去遊樂園。為了做決定，班長請大家舉手表決。最後遊樂園贏了。Ivy 看起來有點失望，所以我主動說要跟她一起坐雲霄飛車。「也許畢業後，我們可以一起去花蓮。」我說，她笑了。老師提醒我們，出發前還要先考完期末考。「先用功讀書，」她說，「再好好去玩！」
